name: 09_uk_tax_ids_context
description: Checksum-valid ЄДРПОУ and РНОКПП with a context keyword within 5 tokens: high-precision TAX_ID. Codes cover the three ЄДРПОУ weight ranges (21045679 normal weights; 38126404 range 30M-60M; 64001830 above 60M) and the second-round case (10000062). Values are in README.md.

blocks.text: 1.1. Страхувальник (код ЄДРПОУ 21045679) та Страховик (код за ЄДРПОУ 38126404).
